response.justification: While Bogdan meets the minimum requirement of 15 years of software engineering experience and possesses a strong entrepreneurial background, he lacks the deep, recognized expertise in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning required for this Director-level AI Strategy role. His AI experience appears limited to a very recent role, and his profile aligns more with a senior full-stack developer than a strategic Principal Engineer advising enterprise customers on cutting-edge AI.
strengths: Over 15 years of diverse software engineering experience across multiple tech stacks.
Demonstrated entrepreneurial experience as the founder of GISCollective.
Strong track record of technical community building, open-source contributions, and leading workshops.
concerns: Lacks the deep, recognized expertise in AI/ML strategy and AI-powered product development required for the role.
No demonstrated experience acting at a Director-level individual contributor capacity advising strategic enterprise customers.
AI experience is limited to a single, very recent role, missing the preferred advanced degree or extensive background in AI.
